intermediate.name: Vado della Forcella
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (2) Vado della Forcella (104.9 km)
Red Bull KM Sprint | Tagliacozzo (155.2 km)

story: Numerous attacks marked the start of the stage before the pace settled and a seven-rider breakaway formed. The breakaway was caught on the final climb. Bernal’s late attack was quickly neutralised, before Ayuso accelerated inside the final 400 metres to win the stage. Pedersen lost significant time and with it the maglia rosa.
